scope: Every event the published hooks reference names. The host accepts a camelCase and a PascalCase spelling for most events; each name below is the spelling Reconc writes.

events.name: errorOccurred
events.reason: the reference states hook output is not processed for this event, so it can neither decide nor contribute evidence

events.name: userPromptTransformed
events.reason: rewrites the model-facing prompt only; the submitted prompt is already observed through UserPromptSubmit
